$comment: Logical scoped capability/role authorization model for Rooms and Spaces.

CapabilityGrant.scope_ref: Room/Space/Topic or other explicitly supported scope
CapabilityGrant.grantable_scope: optional delegation ceiling; absent means this grant is not delegable

Restriction.restricted_capability_or_class: specific action or bounded action class
Restriction.expiry: optional expiry with declared time semantics

Rule: Valid grants union first; explicit active restrictions subtract authority. manage_roles alone never permits grants beyond the actor's authenticated grantable ceiling.
